6.
What is the annual demand for raw material 'OC' and 'OE'?
(A)  1,000 kgs & 400 kgs respectively.
(B)  4,000 kgs & 1,600 kgs respectively
(C)  12,500 kgs & 5,000 kgs respectively.
(D)  50,000 kgs & 20,000 kgs respectively
(2 Marks)
